The '''battle of Agora''' was a conflict during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom|Freedom's Sons]], a pro-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] vigilante group. The Confederacy was ultimately victorious, and the battle became yet another indicator that the Republic's command structure was functioning improperly.
